main.description: Issues a policy-declared label for an account or record.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The operation or target is malformed.

errors.name: InvalidTarget
errors.description: The target is not a valid account or complete record identity.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The authenticated issuer does not have permission to issue labels.

errors.name: ValueNotDeclared
errors.description: The label value is not declared by the current policy.

errors.name: TargetNotAllowed
errors.description: The current policy does not allow labels for this target.

errors.name: TargetResolutionFailed
errors.description: The target could not be resolved.

errors.name: TargetNotFound
errors.description: The target record could not be found or verified.

errors.name: CidMismatch
errors.description: The requested record version does not match the current record.

errors.name: TimestampExhausted
errors.description: A representable creation timestamp could not be chosen.

errors.name: StaleDecision
errors.description: The label state changed during the operation.

errors.name: IssuanceClosed
errors.description: The labeler is not accepting issuance operations.

errors.name: IdempotencyConflict
errors.description: The operation identifier was already used for a different request.

errors.name: MaintenanceActive
errors.description: Label changes are paused during signing-key maintenance.

errors.name: SigningFailed
errors.description: The labeler could not sign the label.

errors.name: StorageUnavailable
errors.description: The operation could not be completed because storage is unavailable.

errors.name: OutcomeUnknown
errors.description: The operation outcome is uncertain; recover it using the same operation identifier.

errors.name: ServiceUnavailable
errors.description: The labeler service is temporarily unavailable.
